name: Banner
label: Banner
description: Full-width status strip for page-level announcements, with an action slot and optional dismissal.

props.name: variant
props.description: Status variant determines colour and default icon

props.name: title
props.description: Short leading emphasis before the body text. Deliberately shadows the native `title` attribute — a banner never needs a hover tooltip.

props.name: children
props.description: Banner body content — a single line of text, rendered inside the banner's paragraph

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon override — Material Symbol name (string) or custom element (ReactNode)

props.name: action
props.description: Action slot on the trailing edge, for a compact Button or link

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether the banner shows a dismiss button

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Callback when the dismiss button is clicked

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the dismiss button.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal alignment of the banner content
